scope: Six pre-existing topology categories; independent H charge, discharge, export and VPP/aggregation-control dispositions. Legal evidence only; no statistical promotion.

status_semantics.YES: Current claim-specific authority and all stated applicability/actual topology/contract predicates established; no promotion from capability or reference diagram.
status_semantics.NO: An affirmative applicable prohibition/exclusion established for precisely the stated operation and entity boundary; not an absence of proof.
status_semantics.OPEN: Insufficient claim-specific authority/applicability evidence after identified primary-source research; operation disabled and exact acquisition route retained.
